text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Royce and Royce stopped in front 
of a toy store window display—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh? ...I knew it! This is that toy car I 
saw in a catalog long ago!

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Aww, so cute! Your eyes are so perfectly 
round! And your little bottom is so 
plump!"

text_block_list.name: Royce's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! If you like it, should I go buy it 
for you?"

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... I'm fine! I'll buy it myself! This 
is a collector's pride, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ That's one dream from back then 
checked off the list♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce got her hands on a 
memorable souvenir and enjoyed her day off 
to her heart's content!
